screens.name: hud
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate only the single screen specified below. Attached images are style references for the same game, not screens to reproduce. Generate one 16:9 full-screen PC game UI mockups for "Yokai Fighters" (Japanese folklore roguelite fighter). One image, full bleed, no device frame, no collage. Match the existing title / settings / pause concepts exactly: flat toon cel colour, ink-brush outlines, matte, no gloss, no neon, no real kanji, no watermark. Palette: indigo #2D3A5E, ink #1D1B21, rice paper #F1E8D4, pine #34483B, shrine red #B5332B, persimmon #D8632C. Brush lettering for headings only; bold serif body text; torn-edge rice-paper sheets over night-bamboo/moon/torii backdrops (or the dimmed bamboo stage in-fight); red brush-stroke selection; key-chip footers; fox-mask corner motif. Extremely legible, aligned, no filler decoration. Characters: Ryo (apprentice exorcist), Kitsune (fox yokai); never show a Tanuki.
SCREEN TO GENERATE:
1 HUD - mid-fight over bamboo stage. Top-left Ryo bar full red "RYO · 1000 / 1000"; top-right Kitsune bar persimmon 60% "KITSUNE · 600 / 1000". Under Ryo: 3-segment meter (one filled, one 40%, one empty) "METER 140 / 300" and a round red "B" burst seal. Two small distant fighters.
Preserve quoted UI text exactly. Render only this screen, no sheet of alternatives.
